description: Kiosk Satellite shows the hidden Kitchen Weather dashboard (/kitchen-weather/weather, Meridian forecast with the animated sky) as its screensaver 5:30-8:00 am (screensaver.schedule, set in KS). KS widgets draw over every screensaver mode, so they go off for that slot and back on for the photos. KS's At a glance row stays off (screensaver.glance_enabled false in KS).
